response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM status_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate, sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_rate AS excess_over_first FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_rate), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM first_kept), second_kept AS (SELECT fk.avg_pulse_rate, fk.excess_over_first, fk.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_rate AS excess_over_second FROM first_kept AS fk CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm WHERE fk.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_remaining_pulse_rate, AVG(excess_over_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(excess_over_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM second_kept;
